title: Abang Din Paip
genre: Malay country-folk with harmonica (1980s Kembara lane)
subject: a plumber called Abang Din who comes to fix a dripping kitchen tap, finds three more leaks, and stays for teh o while the pipes are off
caption: Malay country-folk with harmonica, 1980s Malaysian folk-rock storytelling lineage. Steel-string acoustic strumming in a train beat, harmonica fills between lines, brushed snare, walking bass, slide guitar fills. Dry wooden live-room sound. Male baritone, plain storytelling delivery with a slight grin. 100 BPM, G major. Easygoing, wry and neighbourly. No autotune, no trap drums, no synth pads, no EDM drop, no slow rock power ballad.
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar and harmonica]

[Verse 1]
Paip dapur titik siang malam
Saya telefon Abang Din
Dia datang naik motor buruk
Kotak besi, spanar karat

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia ketuk sini, ketuk sana
Dia kata, ada lagi tiga

[Chorus]
Abang Din paip, Abang Din paip
Satu bocor jadi empat
Air tutup, cerek tak boleh masak
Kita minum teh o sejuk

[Verse 2]
Bawah singki penuh baldi
Dia cerita anak dia kahwin
Getah lama dia tunjuk saya
Macam doktor tunjuk gigi

[Chorus]
Abang Din paip, Abang Din paip
Empat bocor semua siap
Dia caj harga satu je
Sebab teh o tadi sedap

[Outro - harmonica solo and slide guitar]
